FAQ

Got questions about branded
web design? We have answers.

What is a branded website?

A branded website goes beyond generic web design. It is custom engineered around your visual identity, values, tone of voice, and business goals. Every layout, color palette, typography choice, and interaction is designed to communicate brand authority and convert your target audience.

What brand identity services does Lordevs offer?

Lordevs provides full-spectrum digital brand services including bespoke website design, visual identity systems (logos, typography, color palettes, icon design), digital rebrands, brand positioning strategy, custom Webflow/WordPress design, and design system creation.

Can you help refine our existing brand identity?

Yes! Whether you need a complete rebrand or a modern brand refresh, we audit your existing visual elements, elevate your visual language, and apply it seamlessly to a newly redesigned website without losing your established brand equity.

How long does a brand website design project take?

A standard branded business website typically takes 4–8 weeks depending on project scope, custom interactive requirements, and content readiness. We provide a structured roadmap during kickoff to keep all creative deliverables on schedule.

What is included in your brand design guidelines?

Our brand style guides include logo usage rules, typography scales, primary and secondary color schemes, component libraries, digital asset guidelines, and tone-of-voice recommendations to ensure brand consistency.

Will our team be able to manage and update the branded website?

Absolutely. We build sites on intuitive CMS platforms (Webflow, WordPress, or Headless options like Sanity) and provide full training so your internal marketing team can publish pages and update content without breaking design integrity.

How do you ensure our branded website aligns with SEO?

Design and performance go hand in hand. We optimize site structure, semantic markup, meta data, and site speed so your website ranks highly on Google while looking stunning to visitors.

Do you provide original copy and content design?

Yes. We offer brand messaging and copywriting assistance to ensure your site's headline hooks, section descriptions, and calls-to-action reflect your brand's unique voice.

What makes Lordevs different from traditional design agencies?

We fuse high-end design artistry with technical engineering. Instead of using generic templates, we create tailored digital experiences focused on brand authority, conversion rates, and long-term business growth.

Do we own all creative assets and brand files upon completion?

Yes. You maintain 100% ownership of all brand guidelines, source design files (Figma), website code, CMS accounts, and custom visual assets after final project handover.

How do we get started on a branded web project?

You can schedule a free 30-minute Brand Strategy Call through our booking calendar. We will review your goals, evaluate your current web presence, and present a custom proposal with clear timelines and deliverables.

Do you offer post-launch design and brand support?

Yes. We offer ongoing brand design retainers and website maintenance plans to help you scale your brand assets, design new landing pages, and maintain peak performance as your business grows.
